youtube.title: Rust vs Python: Same Code, 86x Faster? 🦀 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Rust vs Python, same code: Rust finished in 0.19 s, Python took 16.4 s, 86x slower. Real benchmark, same machine, median of 5 runs.

📌 In this short:
✅ The same Collatz loop in Rust, JavaScript and Python
✅ Why: Rust compiles to machine code ahead of time, Python interprets every step
✅ Memory too: counting words in a 96 MB file, Rust used 100 MB, Java 1438 MB

🎬 Full video (Rust vs C, Go, Java, JavaScript & Python, 4 rounds): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fmdfgTWni7k
💻 All the code: https://github.com/ShreyashSarage/Youtube_automation/tree/main/longform/rust-speed/project

Follow for a new Rust lesson every day at 10 AM IST, from zero to pro 🦀
💬 What should I benchmark next? Tell me in the comments 👇

#rust #rustlang #python #programming #coding #benchmark #rustvspython #performance #learnrust #developer #shorts

scenes.say: Same loop, same machine. Python: 16 seconds. Rust: 0.19.

scenes.heading: The test: Collatz
scenes.say: The test: for every number below a million, halve it if it's even, or triple it and add one if it's odd, until it reaches one. Keep the longest chain. About a hundred and thirty million steps.
scenes.captions: The test: for every number below a million, halve it if it's even, or 3n + 1 if it's odd, until it reaches 1. Keep the longest chain. About 130 million steps.

scenes.heading: Same answer everywhere
scenes.caption: 837799 · 525 steps
scenes.say: Every language finds the same answer: eight three seven seven nine nine, with five hundred twenty five steps.
scenes.captions: Every language finds the same answer: 837799, with 525 steps.

scenes.heading: Median of 5 runs
scenes.label: Rust 0.19 s vs Python 16.4 s
scenes.say: Median of five runs: Rust 0.19 seconds, Python 16.4. 86 times faster. And Rust tied C.

scenes.heading: Why?
scenes.say: Why? Rust compiles your loop to machine code before it runs. Python's interpreter works through every step at run time, checking types on every plus and modulo.

scenes.heading: Memory: 96 MB file
scenes.say: Memory too. Counting words in a ninety six megabyte file: Rust used 100 megabytes, Go 409, Java about one point four gigabytes.
scenes.captions: Memory too. Counting words in a 96 MB file: Rust used 100 MB, Go 409, Java about 1.4 GB.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.say: Recap: Rust matches C, beats Python by 86 times, and uses a fraction of the memory.
